brand.subtitle: dev-box panel
alerts.title: Alerts
header.updateTitle: Claude Code {latest} available (installed {current}) — click to update
notif.unsupported: this browser does not support notifications
notif.alreadyOn: notifications are already on — turn them off in the browser's site settings, or in Settings
notif.blocked: notifications are blocked in the browser — allow them in the site permissions
notif.enabled: notifications on — you will be told when Claude finishes or asks something
app.updated: The panel was updated on the server (v{v}). This tab still runs the previous version.
login.hint: sign in to access the panel
files.empty: empty folder — drop files here to upload
files.confirmDeleteDir: Delete "{name}" and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
files.outsideTitle: symlink pointing outside /root — the panel does not open it; you can rename or delete the link
usage.title: Usage & limits
usage.apiNotConfigured: Not configured. Set ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY (an Admin API key) to see API spend.
history.pinTitle: this conversation comes back whenever Claude restarts in this session
history.resumeRunning: This ends the current conversation and reopens continuing this one. OK?
history.resumeShell: Send claude --resume to the session shell?
history.title: Conversations of “{name}”
history.empty: no conversation recorded yet for this project
logs.footer: files in ~/.claude/logs/ · the container log (start.sh/Caddy) is in your Docker host: docker logs <container>
backup.noOrigin: no origin — skipped by the backup
backup.configureOrigin: set it up: git remote add origin <url>
backup.pushInfo: The push uses `GH_TOKEN` (scope `repo`) or a `gh auth login` done in the terminal. Log in **Logs → Backup**.
backup.fullTitle: includes the conversation history (can be large)
backup.volumeWarn: If the `/root` volume is lost, the Claude login, `panel.json`, 2FA and sessions go with it. A snapshot is made **once a day** in `/root/.claude-backups` (keeps 7) — but it lives **on the same volume**: download it from time to time.
backup.noSnapshots: no snapshot yet — create one above
backup.restore: Restore: extract the `.tgz` into `/root` (`tar xzf config-….tgz -C /root`) and restart the container.
settings.langHint: To add a language, copy panel/src/locales/en.json to <code>.json and translate the values.
settings.notifSub: when Claude finishes or asks something
settings.toastsHint: on-screen toast when a project changes state
settings.browserOn: on — they arrive even with the panel in the background
settings.notifyDoneHint: when it goes idle after ≥5s working
settings.installApp: Install the panel as an app on your phone (browser menu → “Add to Home Screen”) to get notifications there.
settings.defaultsSub: panel.json → defaults (projects without their own config)
settings.idlePauseHint: pauses Claude by itself when idle for too long (frees CPU/memory)
settings.envSub: read only — change it in your container's environment (docker run -e / compose) and restart
settings.secretsInfo: Sensitive values (`PANEL_PASSWORD`, `GH_TOKEN`) never leave the server in full.
period.label: period:
report.unknownTitle: model not in the price table — uses Opus pricing as an estimate
report.estimateNote: Estimated from the public API price table (input/output/cache per model). If you use a subscription (Pro/Max), this is the **API equivalent**, not your bill.
term.copyBlockedMobile: the browser blocked copying — select the text and use the system Copy
term.copyBlocked: the browser blocked copying — use Ctrl+Shift+C
term.selectHint: Long-press and drag to select, then tap Copy. Without a selection, Copy copies everything.
term.pasteHint: The browser did not allow reading the clipboard. Long-press the box below, choose Paste, then Send.
term.pasteBtn: paste from the clipboard (or right click)
term.clients: tmux clients connected to this session (panel + Console)
term.takeOverTitle: disconnects the other clients (the screen size becomes yours)
term.tabHint: · closing the tab does not end the session
term.mouseHint: · selecting with the mouse copies · Ctrl+C copies the selection (no selection = interrupt) · Ctrl+V / right click pastes · Ctrl+Shift+F searches · mouse wheel scrolls
dash.loggedOutClick: logged out — click to log in
dash.pausedTitle: Claude paused for inactivity — uses no CPU/memory until resumed
dash.configure: configure: first line, rename, history, backup, delete
dash.waitingBanner: Claude is waiting for your answer — open the terminal
dash.openRemoteTitle: opens/reconnects remote control — the link stays valid even if you closed the tab on your PC
dash.restartTitle: kills the tmux session (closes remote + Claude) → reopens Claude → restarts remote → sends the first line
dash.powerOnTitle: turns the project on and starts the session
dash.pauseTitle: pauses Claude in this session — frees CPU/memory until you resume
dash.createHint: Creates the folder in `{dir}` + `git init` and starts the project's tmux session.
dash.firstLineHint: Sent to Claude as soon as it is ready, on every start (as the first prompt).
dash.firstLinePh: e.g.: You are Company X's assistant. Greet the customer and offer help.
dash.onRestartHint: What happens to the conversation when Claude restarts in this session (restart, turn on, or restart remote).
dash.noPinned: no pinned conversation yet — pick one in
dash.notGitRepo: this folder is not a git repository
dash.noOrigin: no remote origin — the automatic backup skips this project
dash.renameHint: Renames the **folder on the server**, moves Claude's history and recreates the tmux session (the current conversation ends).
dash.deleteHint: and kills the session. Cannot be undone (the conversation history is kept). Type the name to confirm:
login.phase.url: Authorize on the link below, then paste the code
login.phase.attention: Claude Code is showing a screen the panel does not know yet
acc.logoutConfirm: Log the Claude account out of this server? You will need to log in again.
acc.oauthInfo: Sign-in uses your Claude subscription account (OAuth). The panel answers every Claude Code setup screen for you: open the link, authorize and paste the code. Credentials are stored in `~/.claude` (volume) and survive redeploys.
acc.outdated: **Claude Code is outdated:** installed `{cur}`, available `{latest}`. Update to get fixes and new features.
acc.npmFail: could not check (no access to the registry?)
acc.updateInfo: The update runs `npm i -g` in the container (1–2 min). Open sessions keep the old version until you **Restart** the project on the dashboard. The image pins `CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION` in the Dockerfile — a rebuild goes back to that version.
tfa.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
tfa.on: Login asks for the password **and** the authenticator code.
tfa.step1: 1. Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Bitwarden…) and scan the QR — or type the key:
tfa.step2: 2. Type the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm:
tfa.keep: Keep the key somewhere safe: without the app and the key you lose access to the panel (then only deleting `~/.claude/.panel-totp.json` from a container shell helps).
tfa.warn: This panel exposes a shell on the server. Enable 2FA to require a code from your phone besides the password.
ses.title: Panel sessions
ses.revokeAll: sign out of all other devices
login.connectedFlash: Claude connected — projects waiting on the login screen were restarted
login.copyFail: could not copy — select the link below and copy it
login.s1: 1. Open the link and sign in with your Claude account (Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise)
login.s2: 2. Paste the code shown after you authorize
login.done: Signed in. The login is saved in `~/.claude`, works for every project and survives redeploys.
login.attention: Pick the right option with the keys below. The panel carries on by itself afterwards.
push.iosIntro: On iPhone and iPad, Web Push only works in the **installed app** (iOS/iPadOS 16.4 or newer), not in a Safari tab.
push.ios3: Close Safari and open **Claude Remote** from the Home Screen icon. Log in again (the app has its own cookies).
push.ios4: Come back to this tab and tap **Enable on this device**, then **Allow**.
push.iosInTab: You are in a browser tab right now — install first (steps 1–3).
push.androidIntro: On Android, notifications work in Chrome even without installing; installing gives a full-screen app and a Home Screen icon.
push.and1: Open this panel in **Chrome** (or Edge / Samsung Internet).
push.and2: Tap the menu → **Install app** (or **Add to Home screen**){extra}.
push.and3: Open **Claude Remote** from the icon, tap **Enable on this device** and **Allow**.
push.https: Requires HTTPS (the dev-box behind its gateway). Tapping a notification opens the project's terminal.
push.noServer: Web Push is not available on the server (the web-push package is missing).
push.iosFirst: Install the app from Safari first (steps below), then open it from the Home Screen.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support Web Push.
push.hooksInfo: "Finished" and "waiting" come from Claude Code hooks, so they work with the panel closed. Repeats are merged (same event and project within a few minutes) and at most 12 pushes go out per 10 minutes.
push.noDevices: no devices yet — enable notifications on your phone
push.event.waiting: Claude is waiting for you (permission, question or input)
push.event.crash: A project is in a crash-loop
push.event.login: Claude is logged out / needs login
pushjs.iosHome: On iPhone/iPad, open the panel from its Home Screen icon first (see the steps below).
pushjs.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site — allow them in the browser/system settings.
pushjs.noSw: Service worker not available (the panel must be served over HTTPS).
key.ctrl: Ctrl: tap = next key, tap twice = lock
key.alt: Alt: tap = next key, tap twice = lock
srv.useLogout: use "sign out" to end the current session
srv.panelSignedOut: this panel session was signed out
srv.sessionClash: the project "{name}" already uses the same terminal session ('.' and '_' count as the same character) — pick another name
srv.tooBig: file too big to edit here (>2MB) — use download
srv.binary: binary file (not editable here) — use download
srv.resumeSent: "{name}": claude --resume sent to the session shell
srv.npmNoBinary: npm installed, but Claude Code's native binary did not come (download failed) — click Update again
srv.defaultsSaved: defaults saved (apply to projects without their own config, the next time the session is recreated)
srv.claudeKilled: Claude ended in {sess} — the supervisor opens a new conversation
srv.claudeNotRunning: Claude is not running in this session
srv.badMode: invalid mode (use new, continue or pinned)
srv.convNotInHistory: conversation not found in this project's history
srv.created: project "{name}" created and session started (Claude {claude}, remote {remote})
srv.restartedShell: "{name}": session restarted (shell only — Claude is OFF)
srv.deleted: project "{name}" deleted (folder + session). Claude's history was kept.
srv.claudeWhenOn: "{name}": Claude {v} (project off — applies when turned on)
srv.remoteOff: "{name}": remote OFF (no longer restarted; the current one ends when the session restarts)
srv.pausedNote: (Claude does not reopen in this session while paused)
srv.waitingBody: A question/permission is pending in the terminal.
srv.doneBody: Worked for {s}s and is now waiting.
srv.2faActive: 2FA is already on — enter the current authenticator code to create a new QR
srv.badCodeClock: invalid code — check your phone's clock and try again
srv.2faOn: 2FA on — from now on the login asks for the code
srv.tooManyTerms: too many terminals open in this session — close one before opening another
srv.noPty: node-pty is not available on the server
srv.projectOff: project is off — turn it on in the Dashboard
srv.othersEnded: {n} session(s) ended on the other devices
srv.tooManyEvents: too many event connections open in this session
srv.brokenLink: refused: broken symlink (points to a target that does not exist)
srv.tooManyUploads: too many simultaneous uploads — try again in a few seconds
srv.powerOff: "{name}": OFF — session ended (does not come back when the container restarts)
srv.claudeOff: "{name}": Claude OFF — ended (the session kept only the shell)
srv.remoteOnLater: "{name}": remote ON (sent once the session/login is ready)
dash.autoResumeTitle: Usage limit hit: the panel types "continue" by itself after the reset
srv.alert.pushFailed: Backup of "{name}": local commit done, but the push failed (remote/credentials/network?).
srv.alert.memHigh: Container memory at {pct}% — backup postponed and panel slowed down until it drops.
srv.alert.rolledBack: Claude {cur} kept crashing — automatically went back to {good}.
srv.alert.rollbackFailed: Claude {cur} kept crashing and going back to {good} failed — see Logs → Sessions.
srv.alert.crashLoop: Claude crashed {n} times in a row (last code {rc}) — stopped restarting it. See Logs → Sessions.
srv.updated: Claude Code updated: {v}. Running sessions keep the old version until they restart.
srv.remoteResent: remote re-sent: {cmd} — the link shows up on the card in a few seconds
srv.noLoginTap: no login in progress — tap Connect Claude
srv.pushMissing: web push unavailable on the server (web-push not installed)
srv.push.limitResume: {name}: {msg} — it continues by itself at {time} UTC.
srv.push.workedFor: Worked for {s}s. Ready for your next instruction.
srv.push.wait.question: Claude has a question for you — {name}
srv.push.wait.input: Claude is waiting for your input — {name}
srv.push.crashBody: Claude keeps exiting; the supervisor stopped restarting it.
srv.push.loggedOutBody: Sessions cannot run until you log in again (Account page).
srv.push.bootBody: The panel is back online. Projects marked "on" are starting again.
srv.push.testBody: Notifications are working on this device.
srv.push.resumedBody: The usage limit was reset; sent "{text}".
disk.title: Disk
disk.cleanAsk: Remove {n} old agent work copies ({size})? Only copies with no unsaved changes and nothing running inside are removed.
disk.hint: Agents create a full copy of the project for each task. Copies untouched for {days}+ days, with no unsaved changes and nothing running, can be removed.
srv.push.resumedRestartBody: The panel restarted in the middle of a task: typed "{text}" so Claude continues.
srv.update.started: Update started: the panel restarts in a few minutes. Interrupted tasks continue by themselves.
srv.update.notConfigured: Set DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_URL to update from the panel.
srv.update.waiting: Waiting for these projects to finish their task: {names}. The update starts as soon as they are idle.
settings.updateSub: Rebuilds and restarts the panel through your deploy hook (DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_URL).
settings.updateIdle: No project is in the middle of a task: updating now does not interrupt anything.
settings.updateBusy: Working now: {names}. "When idle" waits for them to finish; tasks cut by a restart continue by themselves.
settings.updateWaiting: Waiting for {names} to finish. The update starts as soon as every project is idle.
backup.volumeSub: Daily copy of the whole /root to another disk; only what changed takes space.
backup.volumeOff: Off. Set `VOLUME_BACKUP_DIR` to a folder on another disk or mount (e.g. a host folder bound at `/backup`).
backup.volumeNever: no copy yet (the first one runs 10 minutes after start)
cmd.placeholder: Type a page, project or action…
cmd.hint: ↑ ↓ to move · Enter to open · Esc to close
push.event.update: Claude Code was updated (or the update failed)
srv.update.noLatest: could not read the latest version from npm
srv.update.upToDate: Claude Code is up to date ({v})
srv.update.autoBody: Was {from}. New sessions and restarts use the new version.
settings.autoUpdateClaudeHint: Checks every few hours and installs new versions; goes back if the new one does not run. Running sessions switch when they restart.
srv.chatBusy: Claude is still answering in this conversation
srv.chatTooMany: at most {n} chats can run at the same time in this project
srv.chatNotRunning: nothing is running in this conversation
chatlink.title: Chat link
chatlink.hint: A private link to chat with Claude in this project from a phone (add it to the Home Screen). Owner: full power. Limited: only file tools inside the project, sees only its own conversations.
chatlink.label: Name (who is it for?)
chatlink.revokeAsk: Revoke the link "{label}"? Whoever has it loses access at once.
chatlink.copyOnce: Copy this link now: it is shown only once.
chat.title: Chat
chat.emptyListHint: Ask Claude anything about this project.
chat.emptyConversation: Send a message to start. You can attach photos and files.
chat.noMedia: No photos or videos in this conversation.
chat.waitUploads: Wait for the attachments to finish uploading
chat.busy: Claude is still answering in this conversation
chat.invalidLinkHint: It may have been revoked. Ask the owner for a new link.
chat.offlineHint: Check your internet and try again.
chat.tooMany: Too many replies running in this project. Try again in a moment.
term.attachBtn: send an image to the terminal (you can also drag it or paste it)
term.dropHere: Drop to send to the terminal
term.uploaded: {n} file(s) sent: path typed in the terminal
files.discardAsk: "{name}" has unsaved changes. Leave and discard them?
chatlink.copyFailed: Could not copy: the link is selected, copy it by hand
